name: Symbiotic Link
additional_info: Blue Cords (Allies) gain a speed boost, 20% damage resistance, and a 5% damage increase. Red Cords (Enemies) gain a minor speed debuff. Allows you to passively see the health bars of your allies. You can only have one active link of each type. Links also break if you go too far from the linked target. When breaking due to the range limitation, there is a 3 second grace period in which they will not break. Allies hitting you won't break your links.
desc: Press X while hovering over an ally to buff them, or while hovering over an opponent to debuff them. The links you create are destroyed when you receive damage from an enemy.
